SpaceCraft
==========

This folder syncs, so it updates itself. When there is a new build it just
appears here -- there is nothing to download and nothing to unzip. Close the
game before playing again if it happens to be open while an update lands.

VERSION.txt says which build is currently here.


To play
-------

Open the Game folder and run SpaceCraft.exe.

Windows will probably say it does not recognise the publisher. That is because
the game is not signed by a company, not because anything is wrong with it:
click "More info" and then "Run anyway".


To play together
----------------

One of you needs to be the host. Either:

  * From the game's main menu, choose "Host Co-op Game" and keep playing. The
    others choose "Join Co-op Game" and type your address.

  * Or run the dedicated server, and everyone -- including whoever started it --
    joins that instead. This one keeps the world safe: it saves, so the world is
    still there tomorrow, and it remembers what each player is carrying.

    Server        for running it on Windows
    Server-Linux  for running it on a Linux machine or a rented box

See the README.txt in each folder.
